findings.source_quote: “Wow!” exclaimed Sharon. “That was really scary, wasn’t it?”
findings.suggested_fix: Translate the exclamation idiomatically into Afrikaans (for example: “Wou!” or “Sjoe!”) and translate “scary” into Afrikaans. Preserve the two-sentence structure. Example fix: “‘Wou!’ roep Sharon uit. ‘Dit was regtig eng, was dit nie?’”
findings.translation_quote: “Woe!” roep Sharon uit. “Dis regtig scary, was dit nie?”

findings.suggested_fix: Replace the English adjective “scary” with an Afrikaans equivalent (e.g., “eng” or “angstaanjaend”) so the sentence is fully in the target language. Example: “Dis regtig eng, was dit nie?”

findings.location: Paragraph that begins “I was so scared. I just stood frozen to the spot. I don’t remember if I screamed, or if I prayed.”
findings.source_quote: I don’t remember if I screamed, or if I prayed.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the duplicated word “of” in the Afrikaans sentence. Example correction: replace “Ek onthou nie of ek geskree het nie, of of ek gebid het.” with “Ek onthou nie of ek geskree het nie, of ek gebid het.”
findings.translation_quote: Ek onthou nie of ek geskree het nie, of of ek gebid het.
